proof:
have hroots : ∀ x : ℝ, (x + 3) ^ 2 = 121 ↔ x = -14 ∨ x = 8 := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hf : (x + 14) * (x - 8) = 0 := by nlinarith [h]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h' | h'
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hs : S = ({-14, 8} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀, hroots]
    simp
  rw [hs]
  norm_num
